title: Work tab: keep list, filter and selection state across pane-tab activation
outcome: Review round 2 (Claude Low, SessionPaneView.tsx render site): only the active pane tab's content is rendered, so switching away from the Work tab unmounts WorkPanel; returning starts a fresh Engram read and a fresh bd list/dep list/show snapshot (up to the 20 s Beads deadline) and drops filters, selection, view choice and collapse state. Docs now state that activation is a refresh trigger. Follow-up: keep the loaded result and view state keyed by workspace tab id across activation (like the Response Board camera state), without turning the explicit-refresh contract into a live subscription. Filed by Fable; not started.
